```lean
theorem lg_target {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [LinearOrder R] [LinearOrder S] [CommRing R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [Ring S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S] [DenselyOrdered R] [Archimedean R] {x y : S} (f : R →+* S) (hf : StrictMono ⇑f) : ArchimedeanClass.mk x ≤ ArchimedeanClass.mk y ↔ ∃ q, 0 < f q ∧ f q * |y| ≤ |x| := by
  split
  · intro h
    have : ∃ n, |x| ≤ n • |y| := ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.1 h (by simp [ne_zero])
    rcases this with ⟨n, hn⟩
    use n
    · exact (ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.2 hn).1
    · rw [mul_comm]
      exact (ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.2 hn).2
  · intro H
    have : ∃ n, |y| ≤ n • |x| := ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk.1 (by simp [H])
    rcases this with ⟨n, hn⟩
    use n
    · exact (ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.2 hn).1
    · rw [mul_comm]
      exact (ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_lt.2 hn).2
```
